notes: Fixed the tool showing overlapping/wrong company categories for markets outside the usual industrial ones (e.g. a grapes-market report was mixing in farmers/growers as if they were manufacturers). The section list and the relevance check now adapt to whatever market you type, instead of using one fixed industrial category list - so a farmer/grower/primary producer is correctly left out of a trade report (packers, exporters, distributors, processors still show up), the same idea now working for any industry, not just the ones tested before today. Also fixed: a wafer-market search no longer pulls in semiconductor/chip companies. Also fixed: the run-history page was showing a company count that didn't match what was actually in the file - it now always matches. Verified with full real test runs on a new market (grapes) and re-verified an already-working market (HDPE Jerry Can) to make sure nothing broke. Admin email for the new admin-only features is fixed in code now, so a plain update (FORCE_UPDATE.bat) is all that's needed - no manual .env editing required on anyone's machine.
